title: New US chip export rules threaten SEA's data center boom, risking incomplete and abandoned projects and forcing neoclouds to replace their Chinese customers
html:
This is a Techmeme archive page. It shows how the site appeared at 1:55 AM ET, November 23, 2026.

The most current version of the site as always is available at our home page. To view an earlier snapshot click here and then modify the date indicated.
summary: Bloomberg : New US chip export rules threaten SEA's data center boom, risking incomplete and abandoned projects and forcing neoclouds to replace their Chinese customers — Washington's new rulebook spells trouble for a multibillion dollar cloud business helping to power the region's data center boom.
